arxiv-1510-04085.title: Inverse and stability theorems for approximate representations of finite groups
arxiv-1510-04085.creator: W.T. Gowers, O. Hatami
arxiv-1510-04085.description: Abstract The U 2 U^{2} norm gives a useful measure of quasirandomness for real- or complex-valued functions defined on finite (or, more generally, locally compact) groups. A simple Fourier-analytic argument yields an inverse theorem, which shows that a bounded function with a large U 2 U^{2} norm defined on a finite Abelian group must correlate significantly with a character.

arxiv-2407-08355.creator: Lie-Juan Li, Li Wang, Melike Mohamedsedik, Li-Na Hu, Bai-Song Xie
arxiv-2407-08355.description: Abstract We propose a new Sauter-like field model with combinatorial multiple potentials consisting of a deep slow-varying and some shallow fast-varying potentials. arxiv-2510-00268.title: Efficient Layer-wise LLM Fine-tuning for Revision Intention Prediction
arxiv-2510-00268.creator: Zhexiong Liu, Diane Litman
arxiv-2510-00268.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown extraordinary success across various text generation tasks; however, their potential for simple yet essential text classification remains underexplored, as LLM pre-training tends to emphasize generation over classification. While LLMs with instruction tuning can transform classification into a generation task, they often struggle to categorize nuanced texts.

arxiv-2511-20630.title: Quantum-Resistant Authentication Scheme for RFID Systems Using Lattice-Based Cryptography
arxiv-2511-20630.creator: Vaibhav Kumar, Kaiwalya Joshi, Bhavya Dixit, Gaurav S. Kasbekar
arxiv-2511-20630.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vaibhav Kumar, Kaiwalya Joshi, Bhavya Dixit, Gaurav S. Kasbekar. We propose a novel quantum-resistant mutual authentication scheme for radio-frequency identification (RFID) systems. Our scheme uses lattice-based cryptography and, in particular, achieves quantum-resistance by leveraging the hardness of the inhomogeneous short integer solution (ISIS) problem. In contrast to prior work, which assumes that the reader-server communication channel is secure, our scheme is secure even when both the reader-server and tag-reader communication channels are insecure.

pmc-10672975.creator: Dorota Gałkowska, Kamila Kapuśniak, Lesław Juszczak

pmc-11432518.description: Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs), a class of important regulatory factors for many biological processes in plants, have received much attention in recent years. pmc-11644980.description: As forward-looking imaging sonar, also called an acoustic camera, has emerged as an important sensor for marine robotics applications, its simulators have attracted considerable research attention within the field. pmc-12528148.title: SPP1+macrophages promote fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transformation during hypoxia in deep fascia of acute compartment syndrome

pmc-12528148.description: BackgroundAcute compartment syndrome (ACS) is a life-threatening condition characterized by elevated intracompartmental pressure leading to ischemia, hypoxia and tissue necrosis. However, the mechanisms underlying the pathological changes in terms of macrophage activation and fibroblast responses remain poorly understood.
